note.question: Should traffic-safety penalties target delivery drivers or the platform, given that platform delivery promises and fees affect driver speeding and customer demand?
note.overview: The paper explicitly formulates a multistage Stackelberg game among government, delivery platform and drivers/customers and solves it by backward induction.
